guide.summary: How numbers behave inside real sentences: dates, clock time, prices, ages, rough amounts and ordinals. The idea that makes it click: Chinese always goes from the biggest unit to the smallest (year, month, day, part of day, hour, minute), counts large numbers in 万 (ten thousands) rather than thousands, and gives every small word (多, 半, 左右, 第, 零) one fixed slot around the number and its measure word.

subs.label: Dates and time order: 年 月 号 星期 上午 点
subs.focus: Force time units from largest to smallest (年, 月, 号/日, 星期, 上午/下午, 点, 分) with the whole time expression before the verb. Classic errors: English order (三点下午, 五号十月), time at the end of the sentence, 日 in a spoken sentence. Order items cut the time expression into tiles.

subs.label: Clock time: 点, 分, 刻, 半, 差
subs.focus: Force the choice of the right clock word and its slot: 两点 (never 二点) for two o'clock, 半 and 一刻/三刻 after 点, 零 before single-digit minutes (九点零五分), and 差 + minutes + hour for 'to'. Classic errors: 二点, 半两点, 两点三十半, 五分差八点, and using 小时 (duration) where 点 (clock time) is needed.

subs.label: 零 inside numbers, 万 and 亿
subs.focus: Force the correct reading of a number: one 零 for a skipped middle place (一百零五, 两千零八), 一十 inside a bigger number (一百一十), and four-digit grouping with 万 and 亿 (十万, 一百万). Classic errors: 一百五 meant as 105, 一百十, 十千, 一百千. The English cue must fix the exact number.

subs.label: Prices: 块, 毛, 分 and 元
subs.focus: Force the right money unit and its order: 块 then 毛 then 分 in speech, 元 in written or formal prices, 两块 for two, the last unit dropped (三块五), and 零 when 毛 is skipped (三块零五分). Classic errors: 二块, units in the wrong order, 钱 put before the number, and adding 是 or 有 before a price that needs neither.

subs.label: Rough numbers: 多, 左右, 几
subs.focus: Force the slot of 多 (round number: 二十多个; one to nine: 三个多月), 左右 after the number phrase, and 几 for a small unknown number (几个, 十几个, 几十个). Classic errors: 三多个月, 二十个多人, 左右七点. Options are the same word in different slots, or 多 / 几 / 左右 against each other.

subs.label: 第 and when it is dropped
subs.focus: Force the choice between 第 + number + measure (第二次, 第三个) and the bare number for months, dates, weekdays, floors and grades (二月, 三楼, 二年级), plus the contrast with counting (二月 February, 两个月 two months). Classic errors: 第二月, 第两次, 两月, and dropping a required 第 (我二次来).

subs.label: 半: 半个小时, 一个半小时, 两天半
subs.focus: Force the slot of 半: before the measure when there is no whole number (半个小时, 半年), after the measure and before the noun when there is one (一个半小时, 三个半月), and at the very end when the unit is its own measure (两天半, 三年半, 一岁半). Classic errors: 一个小时半, 一半小时, 两半天, 半个年.

subs.label: Phone, room and year numbers digit by digit
subs.focus: Force digit-by-digit reading of phone numbers, room numbers and years: 幺 for one in phone and room numbers, 零 for zero, 二 (not 两) for two. Classic errors: reading a year as a quantity (一千九百九十八年), 两 inside a digit string, 幺 in a year or a counted quantity. Write 幺 where it is read yāo.

subs.label: Age with 岁, percentages and fractions
subs.focus: Force number + 岁 directly after the subject with no 是 and no 个 (他二十岁), 两岁 for two, and the Chinese order of percentages and fractions: 百分之 before the number, denominator + 分之 + numerator (三分之一). Classic errors: 我是二十岁 as the neutral statement, 二十个岁, 八十百分, 百分八十, 一分之三 for one third.

rules.rule: Say time from the biggest unit to the smallest, and put the whole time expression before the verb (after or before the subject).
rules.pattern: 年 + 月 + 号 + 星期 + 上午/下午/晚上 + 点 + 分 + Verb

examples.zh: 我们明天下午三点开会。
examples.py: wǒ men míng tiān xià wǔ sān diǎn kāi huì
examples.en: We have a meeting at three tomorrow afternoon.

examples.zh: 我星期五晚上八点有课。
examples.py: wǒ xīng qī wǔ wǎn shang bā diǎn yǒu kè
examples.en: I have class at eight on Friday evening.

examples.zh: 今天是十一月二十七号，星期五。
examples.py: jīn tiān shì shí yī yuè èr shí qī hào xīng qī wǔ
examples.en: Today is Friday, November the twenty-seventh.

examples.zh: 我的生日是五月二十号。
examples.py: wǒ de shēng rì shì wǔ yuè èr shí hào
examples.en: My birthday is May the twentieth.

rules.note: 号 is what people say; 日 is used in writing and formal announcements (十月一日). Both are correct, so choose by register. 是 is often left out in a positive date or time sentence (今天星期五), but the negative needs 不是.

rules.rule: Hour + 点, then the minutes. Two o'clock is 两点. Half past is 半, a quarter past is 一刻, minutes under ten take 零, and 'X to the hour' is 差 + minutes + the coming hour.
rules.pattern: Hour + 点 + (零) + minutes + (分)   /   Hour + 点 + 半 or 一刻   /   差 + minutes + 分 + Hour + 点

examples.py: xiàn zài liǎng diǎn bàn
examples.en: It's half past two now.

examples.py: wǒ měi tiān qī diǎn yī kè qǐ chuáng
examples.en: I get up at a quarter past seven every day.

examples.py: huǒ chē jiǔ diǎn líng wǔ fēn kāi
examples.en: The train leaves at five past nine.

examples.py: xiàn zài chà wǔ fēn bā diǎn
examples.en: It's five to eight now.

rules.note: Only the hour two is 两; 十二点 and 二十分 keep 二. 分 is usually dropped when the minutes are ten or more (两点二十). Thirty minutes is 半, not 两刻. With 差, 八点差五分 is also heard, but the minutes never go before 差. 点 is a clock time; 小时 is a length of time.

rules.rule: Inside a number, a skipped place in the middle is read as one 零; zeros at the end are not read. Inside a bigger number, ten is 一十.

examples.zh: 这本书一共一百零五页。
examples.py: zhè běn shū yī gòng yī bǎi líng wǔ yè
examples.en: This book has a hundred and five pages in all.

examples.zh: 我们学校有一千零五十个学生。
examples.py: wǒ men xué xiào yǒu yī qiān líng wǔ shí gè xué sheng
examples.en: Our school has one thousand and fifty students.

examples.zh: 今天来了一百一十个人。
examples.py: jīn tiān lái le yī bǎi yī shí gè rén
examples.en: A hundred and ten people came today.

rules.note: In speech the last unit can be dropped, so 一百五 means 150, not 105. Two or more skipped places still take a single 零 (两千零八 for 2008). Before 百 both 二 and 两 are used; before 千, 万 and 亿 most speakers say 两.

rules.rule: Chinese groups digits by four, not three. Count how many ten-thousands (万) there are; a hundred million is 一亿.

examples.py: zhè liàng chē yào èr shí wàn kuài qián
examples.en: This car costs two hundred thousand yuan.

examples.py: zhè ge chéng shì yǒu sān bǎi wàn rén
examples.en: This city has three million people.

examples.py: zhōng guó yǒu shí sì yì rén
examples.en: China has 1.4 billion people.

examples.zh: 他每个月的工资是一万五千块。
examples.py: tā měi gè yuè de gōng zī shì yī wàn wǔ qiān kuài
examples.en: His salary is fifteen thousand yuan a month.

rules.note: There is no 十千 or 一百千: ten thousand is 一万 and a hundred thousand is 十万.

rules.rule: Spoken prices use 块, then 毛, then 分, largest first; two is 两块. The last unit is usually dropped. Written and formal prices use 元.
rules.pattern: number + 块 + number + (毛)   /   number + 元

examples.py: zhè ge miàn bāo liǎng kuài wǔ
examples.en: This bread is two yuan fifty.

examples.py: yī gòng èr shí sān kuài bā máo
examples.en: That's twenty-three yuan eighty altogether.

examples.py: kā fēi sān shí èr kuài yī bēi
examples.en: Coffee is thirty-two yuan a cup.

examples.zh: 这件衣服三百九十九元。
examples.py: zhè jiàn yī fu sān bǎi jiǔ shí jiǔ yuán
examples.en: This piece of clothing is 399 yuan.

rules.note: A price follows the subject directly; 是 and 有 are not needed. 钱 can follow a complete unit (五块钱) but not a dropped one (not 两块五钱). When 毛 is skipped, say 零: 三块零五分. A final two with its unit dropped is 二 (三块二); before 毛 both 两毛 and 二毛 are heard.

rules.rule: 多 means 'and a bit more'. After a round number (ending in 十, 百, 千, 万) it comes before the measure; with a number from one to nine it comes after the measure.
rules.pattern: round number + 多 + Measure + Noun   /   one to nine + Measure + 多 + Noun

examples.zh: 教室里有二十多个学生。
examples.py: jiào shì lǐ yǒu èr shí duō gè xué sheng
examples.en: There are twenty-odd students in the classroom.

examples.py: wǒ xué le sān gè duō yuè hàn yǔ
examples.en: I've studied Chinese for a bit over three months.

examples.py: zhè jiàn yī fu yī bǎi duō kuài qián
examples.en: This piece of clothing is a hundred-odd yuan.

examples.py: tā zài běi jīng zhù le liǎng nián duō
examples.en: He lived in Beijing for over two years.

rules.note: The extra amount is smaller than the last unit named: 二十多 is 21 to 29, 三个多月 is three months and some days. 十 allows both with different meanings: 十多个月 is eleven to nineteen months, 十个多月 is ten months and a bit.

rules.rule: 左右 (about) goes after the number and its measure. 几 stands in for an unknown number under ten: 几个 (a few), 十几个 (a dozen or so), 几十个 (dozens).
rules.pattern: number + Measure + 左右   /   几 + Measure + Noun   /   十几 + Measure   /   几十 + Measure

examples.py: wǒ men qī diǎn zuǒ yòu dào
examples.en: We'll arrive at about seven.

examples.py: tā jīn nián sān shí suì zuǒ yòu
examples.en: He's about thirty this year.

examples.py: wǒ mǎi le jǐ běn shū
examples.en: I bought a few books.

examples.py: zuó tiān lái le shí jǐ gè rén
examples.en: A dozen or so people came yesterday.

rules.note: 大概 means the same as 左右 but goes before the number (大概七点), and the two can be used together. 十几 and 十多 overlap in meaning; 几 cannot follow 百 or 千 directly the way 多 can.

rules.rule: An ordinal is 第 + number + measure, and second is 第二, never 第两. Months, dates, weekdays, floors and school grades are already ordered names, so they take the bare number with no 第.
rules.pattern: 第 + number + Measure + Noun   /   number + 月, 号, 楼, 年级

examples.py: zhè shì wǒ dì èr cì lái zhōng guó
examples.en: This is my second time in China.

examples.py: wǒ zhù zài sān lóu
examples.en: I live on the third floor.

examples.py: tā èr yuè huí guó
examples.en: He goes back to his country in February.

examples.py: wǒ dì di shàng èr nián jí
examples.en: My younger brother is in second grade.

rules.note: Bare number names a position, number + measure counts: 二月 is February but 两个月 is two months; 三楼 is the third floor but 三层楼 is three floors; 第一课 is lesson one but 一节课 is one class.

rules.rule: Half alone: 半 goes before the measure. Whole number plus a half: 半 goes right after the measure. If the unit is its own measure (天, 年, 岁), 半 ends up last.
rules.pattern: 半 + Measure + Noun   /   number + Measure + 半 + Noun   /   number + 天/年/岁 + 半

examples.py: wǒ děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí
examples.en: I waited for half an hour.

examples.py: wǒ men zǒu le yī gè bàn xiǎo shí
examples.en: We walked for an hour and a half.

examples.zh: 我们在上海玩了两天半。
examples.py: wǒ men zài shàng hǎi wán le liǎng tiān bàn
examples.en: We spent two and a half days in Shanghai.

examples.py: tā xué le bàn nián hàn yǔ
examples.en: He studied Chinese for half a year.

rules.note: 天 and 年 never take 个 (半天, 半年, not 半个年), 月 always does (半个月, 一个半月), and 小时 is usually said with 个 but 半小时 is also common. 一半 means 'half of something' (一半的学生), not a duration.

rules.rule: Phone numbers, room numbers and years are read one digit at a time. In phone and room numbers the digit one is said 幺 (yāo); zero is 零 and two stays 二.
rules.pattern: digit + digit + digit ... (+ 年 / 房间 / 号)

examples.py: bào jǐng diàn huà shì yāo yāo líng
examples.en: The police emergency number is 110.

examples.py: wǒ zhù zài sān yāo èr fáng jiān
examples.en: I'm staying in room 312.

examples.zh: 他是二零零八年出生的。
examples.py: tā shì èr líng líng bā nián chū shēng de
examples.en: He was born in 2008.

examples.zh: 我一九九八年来的北京。
examples.py: wǒ yī jiǔ jiǔ bā nián lái de běi jīng
examples.en: I came to Beijing in 1998.

rules.note: 幺 is mainland usage for digit strings (phone, room, some bus routes). It is never used in years, dates, prices or counted quantities, where one is 一. It is normally written 一 and only pronounced yāo; these drills write 幺 to show the reading. Saying yī in a phone number is also understood.

rules.rule: Age is number + 岁 straight after the subject: no 是, no 个, and two years old is 两岁. Ask children 几岁 and adults 多大.

examples.py: tā jīn nián èr shí èr suì
examples.en: He's twenty-two this year.

examples.py: wǒ de hái zi liǎng suì bàn le
examples.en: My child is two and a half now.

examples.py: nǐ de hái zi jīn nián jǐ suì le
examples.en: How old is your child this year?

examples.py: tā dì di hái bù dào shí bā suì
examples.en: His younger brother isn't eighteen yet.

rules.note: 是 is not impossible (it appears for contrast or correction, and 不是 is the negative), but the plain statement has none. When the age is ten or more, 岁 can be dropped in casual speech (他二十二).

rules.rule: Percent is 百分之 + number, the reverse of English. Fractions name the bottom number first: denominator + 分之 + numerator.
rules.pattern: 百分之 + number   /   denominator + 分之 + numerator

examples.zh: 百分之八十的学生都来了。
examples.py: bǎi fēn zhī bā shí de xué sheng dōu lái le
examples.en: Eighty percent of the students came.

examples.zh: 我的手机还有百分之二十的电。
examples.py: wǒ de shǒu jī hái yǒu bǎi fēn zhī èr shí de diàn
examples.en: My phone still has twenty percent battery.

examples.zh: 我们班三分之二的学生是女生。
examples.py: wǒ men bān sān fēn zhī èr de xué sheng shì nǚ shēng
examples.en: Two thirds of the students in our class are girls.

examples.zh: 这个月我花了工资的三分之一。
examples.py: zhè ge yuè wǒ huā le gōng zī de sān fēn zhī yī
examples.en: This month I spent a third of my salary.

rules.note: Read 三分之二 as 'of three parts, two'. One half is normally 一半, not 二分之一, outside maths.

contrasts.wrong: 我们开会三点下午明天。

right.zh: 我们明天下午三点开会。
right.py: wǒ men míng tiān xià wǔ sān diǎn kāi huì
right.en: We have a meeting at three tomorrow afternoon.

contrasts.why: Time goes before the verb and runs from large to small: day, part of day, hour. English order (three, afternoon, tomorrow) is exactly backwards.
The hour two counts hours on the clock, so it is 两 before 点. 二 stays only inside 十二点 and in the minutes (二十分).

right.py: xiàn zài chà wǔ fēn bā diǎn

contrasts.why: 差 comes first: 'lacking five minutes, eight o'clock'. The minutes cannot stand in front of 差.

contrasts.wrong: 他每个月的工资是十千块。

right.zh: 他每个月的工资是一万块。
right.py: tā měi gè yuè de gōng zī shì yī wàn kuài
right.en: His salary is ten thousand yuan a month.

contrasts.why: Chinese has its own unit for ten thousand, 万. 千 never takes a number above nine in front of it.

right.py: wǒ xué le sān gè duō yuè hàn yǔ
right.en: I've studied Chinese for a bit over three months.

contrasts.why: With a number from one to nine, the extra is a fraction of the unit, so 多 follows the measure: 三个多月.

contrasts.wrong: 教室里有二十个多学生。

right.zh: 教室里有二十多个学生。
right.py: jiào shì lǐ yǒu èr shí duō gè xué sheng
right.en: There are twenty-odd students in the classroom.

contrasts.why: After a round number, 多 adds whole extra students, so it sits on the number, before the measure. You cannot have a fraction of a student.

right.py: wǒ men qī diǎn zuǒ yòu dào

contrasts.why: 左右 follows the number phrase. The word that goes in front is 大概.

right.en: He goes back to his country in February.

contrasts.why: Month names are bare numbers. 第 is not used, and 两个月 would mean a length of two months.

right.py: wǒ děng le yī gè bàn xiǎo shí
right.en: I waited for an hour and a half.

contrasts.why: 半 attaches to the measure 个, before the noun 小时. It only comes last when the unit is its own measure, as in 两天半.

contrasts.wrong: 八十百分的学生都来了。

right.zh: 百分之八十的学生都来了。
right.py: bǎi fēn zhī bā shí de xué sheng dōu lái le
right.en: Eighty percent of the students came.

contrasts.why: Percent is said 'of a hundred parts, eighty': 百分之 first, then the number, and 之 cannot be left out.

cheat: Time goes big to small (年 月 号 星期 下午 点 分) and the whole lot sits before the verb.
Counting two of something is 两: 两点, 两块, 两岁, 两天半. Inside 十二, 二十, 第二, 二月 and digit strings it stays 二.
A gap in the middle of a number gets one 零: 一百零五. 一百五 is 150.
Think in 万: 10,000 is 一万, 100,000 is 十万, a million is 一百万.
多: round number, then 多, then measure (二十多个); one to nine, measure first (三个多月).
半 alone goes before the measure (半个小时); with a whole number it goes after the measure (一个半小时, 两天半).
左右 comes after the number; 百分之 and 分之 come before it: 七点左右, 百分之八十, 三分之一.

items.q: 经理说会议定在___。
items.zh: 经理说会议定在十月五号下午三点。
items.py: jīng lǐ shuō huì yì dìng zài shí yuè wǔ hào xià wǔ sān diǎn
items.en: The manager said the meeting is set for 3 p.m. on October 5th.
items.why: Chinese runs big to small: month, day, part of day, hour. The English-style small-to-large orders are not used in Chinese.

items.q: 我___去医院看牙。
items.zh: 我星期五上午去医院看牙。
items.py: wǒ xīng qī wǔ shàng wǔ qù yī yuàn kàn yá
items.en: I'm going to the hospital to see the dentist on Friday morning.
items.why: The day comes before the part of day: 星期五上午. 上午星期五 puts the smaller unit first, and slipping 在 in between does not repair the order.

items.q: 这家公司是___成立的。
items.zh: 这家公司是一九九八年六月成立的。
items.py: zhè jiā gōng sī shì yī jiǔ jiǔ bā nián liù yuè chéng lì de
items.en: The company was founded in June 1998.
items.why: The year comes first and the month after it. 六月一九九八年 copies the English order of month before year.

items.q: 今天是___，别忘了交报告。
items.zh: 今天是三月二号星期四，别忘了交报告。
items.py: jīn tiān shì sān yuè èr hào xīng qī sì bié wàng le jiāo bào gào
items.en: Today is Thursday, March 2nd, so don't forget to hand in the report.
items.why: Month, day, then weekday: 三月二号星期四. The date goes from the bigger unit to the smaller one, never day before month.

items.q: 体检的时间是___，请空腹来。
items.zh: 体检的时间是下周二上午八点，请空腹来。
items.py: tǐ jiǎn de shí jiān shì xià zhōu èr shàng wǔ bā diǎn qǐng kōng fù lái
items.en: The check-up is at 8 a.m. next Tuesday; please come on an empty stomach.
items.why: The week and weekday come first, then the part of day, then the hour: 下周二上午八点. Putting 上午八点 first reverses the large-to-small order.

items.q: 部门聚餐定在___，地点还没有确定。
opts: 下个月十八号星期六晚上七点
下个月晚上七点十八号星期六
晚上七点星期六十八号下个月
items.zh: 部门聚餐定在下个月十八号星期六晚上七点，地点还没有确定。
items.py: bù mén jù cān dìng zài xià gè yuè shí bā hào xīng qī liù wǎn shàng qī diǎn dì diǎn hái méi yǒu què dìng
items.en: The department dinner is set for 7 p.m. on Saturday the 18th of next month, but the venue isn't settled.
items.why: The whole expression runs month, date, weekday, part of day, hour. Any option that starts with the hour or part of day reverses the big-to-small order.

items.q: 医生让我___来复查，还要带上上次的报告。
items.zh: 医生让我下个月八号上午十点来复查，还要带上上次的报告。
items.py: yī shēng ràng wǒ xià gè yuè bā hào shàng wǔ shí diǎn lái fù chá hái yào dài shàng shàng cì de bào gào
items.en: The doctor told me to come back for a follow-up at 10 a.m. on the 8th of next month and to bring the last report.
items.why: Month, date, part of day, hour: 下个月八号上午十点. English-style small-to-large orders sound wrong in Chinese.

items.zh: 会议在星期五下午两点开始。
items.py: huì yì zài xīng qī wǔ xià wǔ liǎng diǎn kāi shǐ
items.en: The meeting starts at 2 p.m. on Friday.
items.why: The weekday comes before the time of day, and the whole phrase follows 在 and sits before 开始. 下午两点星期五 would reverse the order.

items.zh: 经理十二月二十号上午出差。
items.py: jīng lǐ shí èr yuè èr shí hào shàng wǔ chū chāi
items.en: The manager is going on a business trip on the morning of December 20th.
items.why: The time expression is in large-to-small order and sits before the verb, either after the subject or before it. It cannot be left after 出差.

items.s: 我去医院做体检下周二上午九点。
items.s_py: wǒ qù yī yuàn zuò tǐ jiǎn xià zhōu èr shàng wǔ jiǔ diǎn
items.zh: 我下周二上午九点去医院做体检。
items.py: wǒ xià zhōu èr shàng wǔ jiǔ diǎn qù yī yuàn zuò tǐ jiǎn
items.en: I'm going to the hospital for a check-up at 9 a.m. next Tuesday.
items.why: The time expression must stand before the verb phrase. Left at the end it sounds like English word order and is not Chinese.

items.s: 星期五下午四点半我要去牙科复诊。
items.s_py: xīng qī wǔ xià wǔ sì diǎn bàn wǒ yào qù yá kē fù zhěn
items.zh: 星期五下午四点半我要去牙科复诊。
items.py: xīng qī wǔ xià wǔ sì diǎn bàn wǒ yào qù yá kē fù zhěn
items.en: I have a dental follow-up at 4:30 on Friday afternoon.
items.why: Weekday, part of day, then clock time is the correct big-to-small order, and a time phrase may open the sentence before the subject.

items.q: 我们___下班。
items.zh: 我们五点半下班。
items.py: wǒ men wǔ diǎn bàn xià bān
items.en: We finish work at half past five.
items.why: 半 comes right after 点: 五点半. 五半点 reverses them, and 三十 and 半 are two ways of saying the same thing so they cannot be combined.

items.q: 现在是___，该吃药了。
items.zh: 现在是两点，该吃药了。
items.py: xiàn zài shì liǎng diǎn gāi chī yào le
items.en: It's two o'clock now; time to take the medicine.
items.why: Two o'clock is 两点. 两 is used when counting hours, while 二 is kept for digits, ordinals and the tens.

items.q: 现在___八点，我们得走了。
items.zh: 现在差五分八点，我们得走了。
items.py: xiàn zài chà wǔ fēn bā diǎn wǒ men děi zǒu le
items.en: It's five to eight; we have to go.
items.why: 差 comes first: 差五分八点, meaning 'five minutes short of eight'. 五分差 puts the shortfall word after the number.

items.q: 会议___结束，我们可以去吃饭了。
items.zh: 会议十二点一刻结束，我们可以去吃饭了。
items.py: huì yì shí èr diǎn yī kè jié shù wǒ men kě yǐ qù chī fàn le
items.en: The meeting ends at a quarter past twelve, and then we can go for lunch.
items.why: A quarter is one 刻, so quarter past twelve is 十二点一刻. 刻 is not combined with 十五, and the number goes before 刻.

items.q: 体检中心下午___关门，你得早点去。
items.zh: 体检中心下午四点三刻关门，你得早点去。
items.py: tǐ jiǎn zhōng xīn xià wǔ sì diǎn sān kè guān mén nǐ děi zǎo diǎn qù
items.en: The check-up centre closes at a quarter to five p.m., so you have to go early.
items.why: Four fifteen-minute units make a whole hour, so 45 minutes is 三刻: 四点三刻. 四刻 does not exist as a clock time.

items.q: 我每天早上七___起床，然后去跑步。
items.zh: 我每天早上七点起床，然后去跑步。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng qī diǎn qǐ chuáng rán hòu qù pǎo bù
items.en: I get up at seven every morning and then go for a run.
items.why: A clock time uses 点. 小时 measures a stretch of time, so 七小时起床 would mean seven hours of getting up.

items.q: 会议从九点开到十一点，一共开了两___。
items.zh: 会议从九点开到十一点，一共开了两个小时。
items.py: huì yì cóng jiǔ diǎn kāi dào shí yī diǎn yī gòng kāi le liǎng gè xiǎo shí
items.en: The meeting ran from nine to eleven, two hours in total.
items.why: A length of time takes 小时 with its measure 个. 两点 would be the clock time two o'clock, which does not fit 开了.

items.q: 我___有个视频会议，不能去吃饭了。
items.zh: 我两点半有个视频会议，不能去吃饭了。
items.py: wǒ liǎng diǎn bàn yǒu gè shì pín huì yì bù néng qù chī fàn le
items.en: I have a video conference at half past two, so I can't go for lunch.
items.why: Two o'clock is 两点, and 半 follows 点: 两点半. 二点半 uses the wrong two, and 半两点 reverses the order.

items.q: 现在差十分___，李经理还没到办公室，会议可能要推迟。
items.zh: 现在差十分十一点，李经理还没到办公室，会议可能要推迟。
items.py: xiàn zài chà shí fēn shí yī diǎn lǐ jīng lǐ hái méi dào bàn gōng shì huì yì kě néng yào tuī chí
items.en: It's ten to eleven and Manager Li isn't in yet, so the meeting may be delayed.
items.why: After 差 and the minutes comes the hour being approached: 差十分十一点. 十一分 would be minutes and 小时 is a duration, neither names a clock hour.

items.zh: 会议九点一刻才开始。
items.py: huì yì jiǔ diǎn yī kè cái kāi shǐ
items.en: The meeting doesn't start until a quarter past nine.
items.why: The clock time and 才 both come before the verb, with 才 right in front of 开始. The time phrase may open the sentence or follow 会议, but never come after 开始.

items.zh: 现在差五分九点。
items.py: xiàn zài chà wǔ fēn jiǔ diǎn
items.en: It's five to nine now.
items.why: 差 plus the minutes comes before the hour: 差五分九点. The hour cannot come before 差.

items.s: 我们二点半有个会。
items.s_py: wǒ men èr diǎn bàn yǒu gè huì
items.zh: 我们两点半有个会。
items.py: wǒ men liǎng diǎn bàn yǒu gè huì
items.en: We have a meeting at half past two.
items.why: Two o'clock is 两点, not 二点. 二 is only for digit strings, ordinals and the tens.

items.s: 他每天早上八小时上班，晚上六点下班。
items.s_py: tā měi tiān zǎo shàng bā xiǎo shí shàng bān wǎn shàng liù diǎn xià bān
items.zh: 他每天早上八点上班，晚上六点下班。
items.py: tā měi tiān zǎo shàng bā diǎn shàng bān wǎn shàng liù diǎn xià bān
items.en: He starts work at eight every morning and finishes at six in the evening.
items.why: A clock time is 点, not 小时. 八小时 means eight hours of duration, which cannot say when work starts.

items.s: 手术九点零五分开始，大概要两个小时。
items.s_py: shǒu shù jiǔ diǎn líng wǔ fēn kāi shǐ dà gài yào liǎng gè xiǎo shí
items.zh: 手术九点零五分开始，大概要两个小时。
items.py: shǒu shù jiǔ diǎn líng wǔ fēn kāi shǐ dà gài yào liǎng gè xiǎo shí
items.en: The operation starts at 9:05 and should take about two hours.
items.why: A single-digit minute after 点 takes 零, so 九点零五分 is right. 两个小时 is a duration, which correctly uses 小时.

items.q: 这个月公司一共卖了___台电脑。
items.zh: 这个月公司一共卖了一百零五台电脑。
items.py: zhè gè yuè gōng sī yī gòng mài le yī bǎi líng wǔ tái diàn nǎo
items.en: This month the company sold 105 computers in total.
items.why: A skipped tens place needs 零: 105 is 一百零五. 一百五 and 一百五十 both mean 150.

items.q: 这次体检的费用是___块。
items.zh: 这次体检的费用是两千零八块。
items.py: zhè cì tǐ jiǎn de fèi yòng shì liǎng qiān líng bā kuài
items.en: The check-up costs 2,008 yuan.
items.why: The empty hundreds place takes one 零: 两千零八. 两千八 would be 2,800, and 零十八 is wrong because 零 already covers the gap.

items.q: 我们部门一共有___个人。
items.zh: 我们部门一共有一百一十个人。
items.py: wǒ men bù mén yī gòng yǒu yī bǎi yī shí gè rén
items.en: Our department has 110 people.
items.why: Inside a number above 100, ten is said 一十: 一百一十. 一百十 drops the 一 that 十 needs in the middle of a number.

items.q: 这份文件有___页，我今天看不完。
items.zh: 这份文件有二十页，我今天看不完。
items.py: zhè fèn wén jiàn yǒu èr shí yè wǒ jīn tiān kàn bù wán
items.en: This document has twenty pages and I can't finish reading it today.
items.why: Twenty is 二十, with 二 in the tens. 两 is only for counting a measured group, and 二百 would be two hundred.

items.q: 公司今年的利润是___元，比去年多了不少。
items.zh: 公司今年的利润是一百万元，比去年多了不少。
items.py: gōng sī jīn nián de lì rùn shì yī bǎi wàn yuán bǐ qù nián duō le bù shǎo
items.en: The company's profit this year is one million yuan, a good deal more than last year.
items.why: One million is 一百万, a hundred ten-thousands. 十万 is 100,000 and 一千万 is ten million.

items.q: 这个城市有___人，上班的路上总是堵车。
items.zh: 这个城市有两千万人，上班的路上总是堵车。
items.py: zhè gè chéng shì yǒu liǎng qiān wàn rén shàng bān de lù shàng zǒng shì dǔ chē
items.en: This city has twenty million people, and there is always traffic on the way to work.
items.why: Twenty million is two thousand 万: 两千万. 两百万 is two million and 两亿 is two hundred million.

items.zh: 这台机器要一万零五百块。
items.py: zhè tái jī qì yào yī wàn líng wǔ bǎi kuài
items.en: This machine costs 10,500 yuan.
items.why: The empty thousands place between 一万 and 五百 takes one 零: 一万零五百. Without 零 it would read as 15,000 or be ungrammatical.

items.s: 这家医院每年有十千个病人来看病。
items.s_py: zhè jiā yī yuàn měi nián yǒu shí qiān gè bìng rén lái kàn bìng
items.zh: 这家医院每年有一万个病人来看病。
items.py: zhè jiā yī yuàn měi nián yǒu yī wàn gè bìng rén lái kàn bìng
items.en: This hospital sees ten thousand patients a year.
items.why: Chinese counts in units of 万, so 10,000 is 一万. 十千 is never said.

items.s: 我们的年会预算是一百零五万元。
items.s_py: wǒ men de nián huì yù suàn shì yī bǎi líng wǔ wàn yuán
items.zh: 我们的年会预算是一百零五万元。
items.py: wǒ men de nián huì yù suàn shì yī bǎi líng wǔ wàn yuán
items.en: Our annual party budget is 1,050,000 yuan.
items.why: 一百零五 is 105 and 万 multiplies it, giving 1,050,000. The 零 inside 一百零五 is correct, so the sentence is fine.

items.q: 这支笔___，不贵。
items.zh: 这支笔两块，不贵。
items.py: zhè zhī bǐ liǎng kuài bù guì
items.en: This pen is two yuan, so it isn't expensive.
items.why: Two units of money take 两: 两块. 二 is kept for digits and ordinals.

items.q: 这瓶药水一共十三___八毛。
items.zh: 这瓶药水一共十三块八毛。
items.py: zhè píng yào shuǐ yī gòng shí sān kuài bā máo
items.en: This bottle of medicated lotion costs 13.80 yuan in total.
items.why: Spoken prices go 块 then 毛 then 分, so the yuan unit 块 sits before 八毛. 毛 twice would make no sense.

items.q: 这盒创可贴三块五，两盒一共___。
items.zh: 这盒创可贴三块五，两盒一共七块。
items.py: zhè hé chuàng kě tiē sān kuài wǔ liǎng hé yī gòng qī kuài
items.en: A box of plasters is 3.50 yuan, so two boxes come to seven yuan.
items.why: Money amounts take 块 as the unit: 七块. 个 does not count money and 七毛 would be only 0.70 yuan.

items.q: 药费一共两百___，医保已经报销了一半。
items.zh: 药费一共两百块，医保已经报销了一半。
items.py: yào fèi yī gòng liǎng bǎi kuài yī bǎo yǐ jīng bào xiāo le yī bàn
items.en: The medicine cost 200 yuan in total, and insurance already covered half.
items.why: Hundreds of yuan are counted with 块: 两百块. 毛 and 分 are the small units under a yuan.

items.q: 打印店一张彩色的要一块___，黑白的才五毛。
items.zh: 打印店一张彩色的要一块五，黑白的才五毛。
items.py: dǎ yìn diàn yī zhāng cǎi sè de yào yī kuài wǔ hēi bái de cái wǔ máo
items.en: At the print shop a colour page is one yuan fifty, and black and white is only fifty cents.
items.why: In 一块五 the last unit is dropped and means five 毛. 零五 would be 1.05 and 五块 would be five more yuan.

items.q: 一共三块五，我给了他五块，他找了我___。
items.zh: 一共三块五，我给了他五块，他找了我一块五。
items.py: yī gòng sān kuài wǔ wǒ gěi le tā wǔ kuài tā zhǎo le wǒ yī kuài wǔ
items.en: It came to 3.50 and I gave him five yuan, so he gave me one yuan fifty in change.
items.why: The amount is 一块五: yuan first, then the 毛 digit with the last unit dropped. 块 cannot go before the number.

items.zh: 这瓶药一共三块八毛。
items.py: zhè píng yào yī gòng sān kuài bā máo
items.en: This bottle of medicine is 3.80 yuan in total.
items.why: In spoken prices 块 comes before 毛, so 三块八毛 is the order. Reversing them would not make sense.

items.zh: 这支体温计要二十八块五。
items.py: zhè zhī tǐ wēn jì yào èr shí bā kuài wǔ
items.en: This thermometer costs 28.50 yuan.
items.why: The final unit is dropped: 二十八块五 means 28.50. The digit 五 comes after 块, never before it.

items.s: 这杯咖啡三毛五块，不算贵。
items.s_py: zhè bēi kā fēi sān máo wǔ kuài bù suàn guì
items.zh: 这杯咖啡三块五，不算贵。
items.py: zhè bēi kā fēi sān kuài wǔ bù suàn guì
items.en: This coffee is 3.50 yuan, which isn't expensive.
items.why: Spoken prices go from yuan to smaller units: 三块五. 三毛五块 reverses 块 and 毛.

items.s: 这盒药是四十五块，不用找零。
items.s_py: zhè hé yào shì sì shí wǔ kuài bù yòng zhǎo líng
items.zh: 这盒药是四十五块，不用找零。
items.py: zhè hé yào shì sì shí wǔ kuài bù yòng zhǎo líng
items.en: This box of medicine is 45 yuan; no change is needed.
items.why: A price can be stated with 是 plus the amount, and 块 is the normal spoken unit. The sentence is fine as it is.

items.q: 办公室里有二十___同事，大家都很忙。
items.zh: 办公室里有二十多个同事，大家都很忙。
items.py: bàn gōng shì lǐ yǒu èr shí duō gè tóng shì dà jiā dōu hěn máng
items.en: There are twenty-odd colleagues in the office, and everyone is busy.
items.why: After a round number, 多 comes before the measure: 二十多个. 个多 would put the extra part after the measure, which is only for one to nine.

items.q: 我已经三___月没去医院了。
items.zh: 我已经三个多月没去医院了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng sān gè duō yuè méi qù yī yuàn le
items.en: I haven't been to the hospital for over three months.
items.why: With 1 to 9 the measure comes first and 多 after it: 三个多月. 三多个月 reverses them.

items.q: 他每天睡___，睡得太少了。
items.zh: 他每天睡七个小时左右，睡得太少了。
items.py: tā měi tiān shuì qī gè xiǎo shí zuǒ yòu shuì de tài shǎo le
items.en: He sleeps about seven hours a day, which is too little.
items.why: 左右 goes after the whole number phrase: 七个小时左右. It cannot be put in front of the number or inside it.

items.q: 参加会议的只有___人，大部分人都请假了。
items.zh: 参加会议的只有十几个人，大部分人都请假了。
items.py: cān jiā huì yì de zhǐ yǒu shí jǐ gè rén dà bù fēn rén dōu qǐng jiǎ le
items.en: Only ten-odd people attended the meeting; most had asked for leave.
items.why: 十几 is 11 to 19. 几十 means twenty to ninety, which cannot fit 'only'.

items.q: 医生，请问我一天吃___次药？
items.zh: 医生，请问我一天吃几次药？
items.py: yī shēng qǐng wèn wǒ yī tiān chī jǐ cì yào
items.en: Doctor, how many times a day should I take the medicine?
items.why: 几 asks about a small number before a measure: 几次. 多 and 大概 cannot stand directly before 次 as a question word.

items.q: 我们科一共有___医生，护士比医生还多。
items.zh: 我们科一共有三十多个医生，护士比医生还多。
items.py: wǒ men kē yī gòng yǒu sān shí duō gè yī shēng hù shì bǐ yī shēng hái duō
items.en: Our department has thirty-odd doctors, and even more nurses.
items.why: With a round number like 三十, 多 follows the number and comes before the measure: 三十多个.

items.q: 我们等了___，经理才到办公室。
items.zh: 我们等了一个多小时，经理才到办公室。
items.py: wǒ men děng le yī gè duō xiǎo shí jīng lǐ cái dào bàn gōng shì
items.en: We waited more than an hour before the manager reached the office.
items.why: For 1 to 9, the measure comes before 多: 一个多小时. 一多个 reverses them.

items.q: 药费一共花了一百___块。
items.zh: 药费一共花了一百多块。
items.py: yào fèi yī gòng huā le yī bǎi duō kuài
items.en: The medicine cost a little over a hundred yuan altogether.
items.why: After a round number 多 comes before the measure: 一百多块. 个 is not the measure here and cannot follow a hundred.

items.q: 新来的同事看起来___，人很好。
items.zh: 新来的同事看起来三十岁左右，人很好。
items.py: xīn lái de tóng shì kàn qǐ lái sān shí suì zuǒ yòu rén hěn hǎo
items.en: The new colleague looks about thirty and is a nice person.
items.why: 左右 comes after the full number phrase, so 三十岁左右. It does not go before the number or in the middle of it.

items.q: 他为了赶项目，连续加班了___，终于累得生病了。
items.zh: 他为了赶项目，连续加班了十几天，终于累得生病了。
items.py: tā wèi le gǎn xiàng mù lián xù jiā bān le shí jǐ tiān zhōng yú lèi de shēng bìng le
items.en: To meet the project deadline he worked overtime for ten-odd days in a row and finally fell ill.
items.why: 十几 means 11 to 19: 十几天. 几十天 means twenty to ninety days, which does not match.

items.q: 这个小区有___户人家，一家诊所肯定不够用。
items.zh: 这个小区有几千户人家，一家诊所肯定不够用。
items.py: zhè gè xiǎo qū yǒu jǐ qiān hù rén jiā yī jiā zhěn suǒ kěn dìng bù gòu yòng
items.en: This neighbourhood has several thousand households, so one clinic is certainly not enough.
items.why: 几 stands before the unit for an unknown small number: 几千 is several thousand. 千几 reverses them.

items.zh: 他大概三十岁左右。
items.py: tā dà gài sān shí suì zuǒ yòu
items.en: He's roughly thirty.
items.why: 左右 follows the age and 大概 stands before it. 左右 cannot be placed ahead of 三十岁.

items.zh: 我们科有二十多个护士。
items.py: wǒ men kē yǒu èr shí duō gè hù shì
items.en: Our department has twenty-odd nurses.
items.why: With a round number, 多 comes after the number and before the measure: 二十多个. 二十个多 would be wrong.

items.zh: 我等了三个多小时。
items.py: wǒ děng le sān gè duō xiǎo shí
items.en: I waited for over three hours.
items.why: With 1 to 9, the measure comes before 多: 三个多小时. 三多个小时 is wrong.

items.s: 我已经等了二十个多分钟了。
items.s_py: wǒ yǐ jīng děng le èr shí gè duō fēn zhōng le
items.zh: 我已经等了二十多分钟了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng děng le èr shí duō fēn zhōng le
items.en: I've already waited more than twenty minutes.
items.why: After a round number such as 二十, 多 is attached directly to the number and the measure follows. 二十个多分钟 puts 个 in the wrong place.

items.s: 我们公司有一百多个员工，还不到两百个。
items.s_py: wǒ men gōng sī yǒu yī bǎi duō gè yuán gōng hái bù dào liǎng bǎi gè
items.zh: 我们公司有一百多个员工，还不到两百个。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī yǒu yī bǎi duō gè yuán gōng hái bù dào liǎng bǎi gè
items.en: Our company has a hundred-odd employees, still under two hundred.
items.why: 一百 is a round number, so 多 goes before the measure: 一百多个. That is the correct slot.

items.q: 我们公司在___，电梯在左边。
items.zh: 我们公司在三楼，电梯在左边。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī zài sān lóu diàn tī zài zuǒ biān
items.en: Our company is on the third floor; the lift is on the left.
items.why: Floors are said with a bare number: 三楼. 第 is not added to a floor number.

items.q: 我们的会议是在___开的。
items.zh: 我们的会议是在二月开的。
items.py: wǒ men de huì yì shì zài èr yuè kāi de
items.en: Our conference was held in February.
items.why: Months use a plain number with 月: 二月. 第 is dropped, and 两月 is not used for the second month.

items.q: 这是我___来这家医院看病，感觉服务很好。
items.zh: 这是我第二次来这家医院看病，感觉服务很好。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ dì èr cì lái zhè jiā yī yuàn kàn bìng gǎn jué fú wù hěn hǎo
items.en: This is the second time I've come to this hospital for treatment, and the service feels great.
items.why: The second occurrence is 第二次. 两次 would mean 'twice' and cannot follow 这是我 as an ordinal.

items.q: 我儿子今年上___年级，每天自己走路上学。
items.zh: 我儿子今年上二年级，每天自己走路上学。
items.py: wǒ ér zi jīn nián shàng èr nián jí měi tiān zì jǐ zǒu lù shàng xué
items.en: My son is in second grade this year and walks to school by himself every day.
items.why: Grades are named with a bare number: 二年级. 第 is dropped, and 两 is only for counting.

items.q: 我上班___天就迟到了，经理有点生气。
items.zh: 我上班第一天就迟到了，经理有点生气。
items.py: wǒ shàng bān dì yī tiān jiù chí dào le jīng lǐ yǒu diǎn shēng qì
items.en: I was late on my very first day at work, and the manager was a little annoyed.
items.why: 'The first day' is 第一天. A bare 一天 would mean 'one day' of work, not the first day.

items.q: 这是公司成立以来的___次员工体检，大家都很重视。
items.zh: 这是公司成立以来的第五次员工体检，大家都很重视。
items.py: zhè shì gōng sī chéng lì yǐ lái de dì wǔ cì yuán gōng tǐ jiǎn dà jiā dōu hěn zhòng shì
items.en: This is the fifth staff check-up since the company was founded, and everyone takes it seriously.
items.why: The fifth occurrence is 第五次. 五次 would mean 'five times' and would not fit after 的.

items.zh: 我们办公室在三楼。
items.py: wǒ men bàn gōng shì zài sān lóu
items.en: Our office is on the third floor.
items.why: Floors are said as a plain number plus 楼: 三楼. 第三楼 is not used.

items.zh: 这是我第三次来这家诊所。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ dì sān cì lái zhè jiā zhěn suǒ
items.en: This is the third time I've come to this clinic.
items.why: The ordinal 第三次 sits before the verb 来, so 第 + number + measure sets the count of occurrences.

items.s: 今天是第十月三号，银行放假。
items.s_py: jīn tiān shì dì shí yuè sān hào yín xíng fàng jiǎ
items.zh: 今天是十月三号，银行放假。
items.py: jīn tiān shì shí yuè sān hào yín xíng fàng jiǎ
items.en: Today is October 3rd and the banks are closed.
items.why: Months are plain numbers plus 月: 十月. 第 is not used with month names.

items.s: 我们公司二月才开始招人，现在人还不多。
items.s_py: wǒ men gōng sī èr yuè cái kāi shǐ zhāo rén xiàn zài rén hái bù duō
items.zh: 我们公司二月才开始招人，现在人还不多。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī èr yuè cái kāi shǐ zhāo rén xiàn zài rén hái bù duō
items.en: Our company only starts hiring in February, so there aren't many people yet.
items.why: 二月 is simply February, a bare number with 月 and no 第. 两个月 would be 'two months'. The sentence is correct.

items.q: 我中午睡了___。
items.zh: 我中午睡了半个小时。
items.py: wǒ zhōng wǔ shuì le bàn gè xiǎo shí
items.en: I slept for half an hour at noon.
items.why: With no whole number, 半 goes before the measure: 半个小时. 个半小时 needs a number in front.

items.q: 会议开了___，大家都累了。
items.zh: 会议开了一个半小时，大家都累了。
items.py: huì yì kāi le yī gè bàn xiǎo shí dà jiā dōu lèi le
items.en: The meeting ran for an hour and a half and everyone was tired.
items.why: With a whole number, 半 comes after the measure and before the noun: 一个半小时. 一半个 puts it too early.

items.q: 病人在医院住了___，明天可以回家了。
items.zh: 病人在医院住了两天半，明天可以回家了。
items.py: bìng rén zài yī yuàn zhù le liǎng tiān bàn míng tiān kě yǐ huí jiā le
items.en: The patient stayed in hospital for two and a half days and can go home tomorrow.
items.why: When the unit is itself the measure, 半 goes at the very end: 两天半. 两半天 splits the number and the unit.

items.q: 我在这家公司工作了___，打算换工作了。
items.zh: 我在这家公司工作了三年半，打算换工作了。
items.py: wǒ zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò le sān nián bàn dǎ suàn huàn gōng zuò le
items.en: I've worked at this company for three and a half years and plan to change jobs.
items.why: 年 is its own measure, so 半 follows it: 三年半. 三个半年 inserts a measure that 年 does not take.

items.q: 我弟弟今年___了，已经会说很多话了。
items.zh: 我弟弟今年一岁半了，已经会说很多话了。
items.py: wǒ dì dì jīn nián yī suì bàn le yǐ jīng huì shuō hěn duō huà le
items.en: My little brother is one and a half now and can already say lots of words.
items.why: 岁 is its own measure, so 半 comes right after it: 一岁半. 个 is not used with 岁.

items.q: 这种病需要连续吃___的药才能好。
items.zh: 这种病需要连续吃三个半月的药才能好。
items.py: zhè zhǒng bìng xū yào lián xù chī sān gè bàn yuè de yào cái néng hǎo
items.en: This illness needs three and a half months of continuous medication to clear up.
items.why: A whole number and 个 come first, then 半 before the noun: 三个半月. 三半个月 puts 半 before the measure.

items.zh: 他等了一个半小时。
items.py: tā děng le yī gè bàn xiǎo shí
items.en: He waited an hour and a half.
items.why: With a whole number, 半 follows the measure 个 and comes before 小时: 一个半小时.

items.zh: 我午休了半个小时。
items.py: wǒ wǔ xiū le bàn gè xiǎo shí
items.en: I took a half-hour lunch break.
items.why: Without a whole number, 半 goes before the measure: 半个小时, as one tile after 了.

items.zh: 他上班三年半了。
items.py: tā shàng bān sān nián bàn le
items.en: He's been working for three and a half years now.
items.why: 年 is its own measure, so 半 sits at the very end of the phrase: 三年半.

items.s: 他已经在这儿工作了两半年。
items.s_py: tā yǐ jīng zài zhè r gōng zuò le liǎng bàn nián
items.zh: 他已经在这儿工作了两年半。
items.py: tā yǐ jīng zài zhè r gōng zuò le liǎng nián bàn
items.en: He has already worked here for two and a half years.
items.why: 半 follows 年 when 年 is its own measure: 两年半. 两半年 is not a Chinese pattern.

items.s: 他在医院住了三个半月，才完全好起来。
items.s_py: tā zài yī yuàn zhù le sān gè bàn yuè cái wán quán hǎo qǐ lái
items.zh: 他在医院住了三个半月，才完全好起来。
items.py: tā zài yī yuàn zhù le sān gè bàn yuè cái wán quán hǎo qǐ lái
items.en: He stayed in hospital for three and a half months before he fully recovered.
items.why: 月 takes the measure 个 when counting months, and 半 follows the measure: 三个半月. This is the correct slot.

items.q: 这家诊所是___年建的。
items.zh: 这家诊所是一九九八年建的。
items.py: zhè jiā zhěn suǒ shì yī jiǔ jiǔ bā nián jiàn de
items.en: This clinic was built in 1998.
items.why: Years are read digit by digit: 一九九八. Reading it as a quantity, 一千九百九十八, is wrong for a year.

items.q: 我的办公室是___，在电梯左边。
items.zh: 我的办公室是二二零八，在电梯左边。
items.py: wǒ de bàn gōng shì shì èr èr líng bā zài diàn tī zuǒ biān
items.en: My office is room 2208, on the left of the lift.
items.why: Room numbers are read digit by digit and the digit two is 二, not 两. 两千二百零八 would read it as a quantity.

items.q: 他的手机号码以___开头，后面我忘了。
items.zh: 他的手机号码以幺三八开头，后面我忘了。
items.py: tā de shǒu jī hào mǎ yǐ yāo sān bā kāi tóu hòu miàn wǒ wàng le
items.en: His mobile number starts with 138; I've forgotten the rest.
items.why: Phone numbers are read digit by digit, and 一 is commonly said 幺 (yāo) to avoid confusion. A quantity like 一百三十八 does not fit.

items.q: 这家药厂是___年成立的，已经有十几年历史了。
items.zh: 这家药厂是二零一二年成立的，已经有十几年历史了。
items.py: zhè jiā yào chǎng shì èr líng yī èr nián chéng lì de yǐ jīng yǒu shí jǐ nián lì shǐ le
items.en: This pharmaceutical plant was founded in 2012 and has over ten years of history.
items.why: A year is read digit by digit with 二: 二零一二. 两零一二 uses 两 in a digit string, and 两千一十二 reads it as a quantity.

items.zh: 医院是二零一零年建的。
items.py: yī yuàn shì èr líng yī líng nián jiàn de
items.en: The hospital was built in 2010.
items.why: The year is read digit by digit as one tile, 二零一零年, and sits after 是 and before 建.

items.zh: 我的房间号是幺零八。
items.py: wǒ de fáng jiān hào shì yāo líng bā
items.en: My room number is 108.
items.why: Room numbers are read digit by digit, and 一 is said 幺: 幺零八.

items.s: 我的房间号是两零三。
items.s_py: wǒ de fáng jiān hào shì liǎng líng sān
items.zh: 我的房间号是二零三。
items.py: wǒ de fáng jiān hào shì èr líng sān
items.en: My room number is 203.
items.why: Digit strings use 二, not 两: 二零三. 两 is only for counting amounts.

items.s: 我的工号是幺二三四，你记一下。
items.s_py: wǒ de gōng hào shì yāo èr sān sì nǐ jì yī xià
items.zh: 我的工号是幺二三四，你记一下。
items.py: wǒ de gōng hào shì yāo èr sān sì nǐ jì yī xià
items.en: My employee number is 1234; please note it down.
items.why: An ID number is read digit by digit, with 一 said 幺 and 二 for two. The sentence is correct.

items.q: 我爸爸今年六十___，身体还很好。
items.zh: 我爸爸今年六十岁，身体还很好。
items.py: wǒ bà bà jīn nián liù shí suì shēn tǐ hái hěn hǎo
items.en: My dad is sixty this year and still in good health.
items.why: Age is a number plus 岁 directly: 六十岁. 个 is not used with 岁, and 年 counts years of time.

items.q: 我女儿___了，已经会自己吃饭了。
items.zh: 我女儿两岁了，已经会自己吃饭了。
items.py: wǒ nǚ ér liǎng suì le yǐ jīng huì zì jǐ chī fàn le
items.en: My daughter is two and can already feed herself.
items.why: Age two is 两岁, because 两 is used when counting. 二岁 uses the wrong two, and 个 is never inserted before 岁.

items.q: 公司___的员工都参加了体检。
items.zh: 公司百分之九十的员工都参加了体检。
items.py: gōng sī bǎi fēn zhī jiǔ shí de yuán gōng dōu cān jiā le tǐ jiǎn
items.en: Ninety percent of the company's employees took part in the check-up.
items.why: Percentages start with 百分之, then the number: 百分之九十. 九十百分 and 百分九十 are not Chinese.

items.q: 我们部门___是男同事，女同事比较多。
items.zh: 我们部门三分之一是男同事，女同事比较多。
items.py: wǒ men bù mén sān fēn zhī yī shì nán tóng shì nǚ tóng shì bǐ jiào duō
items.en: One third of our department are men; there are more women.
items.why: A fraction is said denominator first: 三分之一, 'one of three parts'. 一分之三 reverses it.

items.q: 公司今年的销售量比去年增长了___。
items.zh: 公司今年的销售量比去年增长了百分之十五。
items.py: gōng sī jīn nián de xiāo shòu liàng bǐ qù nián zēng zhǎng le bǎi fēn zhī shí wǔ
items.en: This year's sales volume grew by fifteen percent compared with last year.
items.why: The pattern is 百分之 + number: 百分之十五. 之 cannot be left out, and the number cannot come before 百分.

items.zh: 我哥哥今年三十岁。
items.py: wǒ gē gē jīn nián sān shí suì
items.en: My older brother is thirty this year.
items.why: Age follows the subject directly as a number plus 岁, with no 是 and no 个. 今年 may sit before or after the subject.

items.zh: 百分之八十的员工都来了。
items.py: bǎi fēn zhī bā shí de yuán gōng dōu lái le
items.en: Eighty percent of the staff came.
items.why: 百分之 comes first and then the number: 百分之八十, followed by 的 and the noun.

items.zh: 他的体重减少了三分之一。
items.py: tā de tǐ zhòng jiǎn shǎo le sān fēn zhī yī
items.en: His weight dropped by a third.
items.why: A fraction names the number of parts first: 三分之一. 一分之三 would reverse numerator and denominator.

items.s: 百分八十的员工都同意了。
items.s_py: bǎi fēn bā shí de yuán gōng dōu tóng yì le
items.zh: 百分之八十的员工都同意了。
items.py: bǎi fēn zhī bā shí de yuán gōng dōu tóng yì le
items.en: Eighty percent of the staff agreed.
items.why: 百分之 is a fixed unit and 之 cannot be dropped: 百分之八十.

items.s: 我儿子今年十个岁了。
items.s_py: wǒ ér zi jīn nián shí gè suì le
items.zh: 我儿子今年十岁了。
items.py: wǒ ér zi jīn nián shí suì le
items.en: My son is ten this year.
items.why: 岁 attaches directly to the number: 十岁. 个 is not used with 岁.

items.s: 全公司只有四分之一的人喜欢这个计划。
items.s_py: quán gōng sī zhǐ yǒu sì fēn zhī yī de rén xǐ huān zhè gè jì huà
items.zh: 全公司只有四分之一的人喜欢这个计划。
items.py: quán gōng sī zhǐ yǒu sì fēn zhī yī de rén xǐ huān zhè gè jì huà
items.en: Only a quarter of the whole company likes this plan.
items.why: 四分之一 has the denominator first and is the correct fraction form for a quarter.

items.q: 他们踢了一个___小时足球。
items.zh: 他们踢了一个半小时足球。
items.py: tā men tī le yī gè bàn xiǎo shí zú qiú
items.en: They played football for an hour and a half.
items.why: With a whole number, 半 goes right after the measure and before the noun: 一个半小时. 半个 would repeat the measure.

items.q: 我女儿今年三岁___了，已经会游泳了。
items.zh: 我女儿今年三岁半了，已经会游泳了。
items.py: wǒ nǚ ér jīn nián sān suì bàn le yǐ jīng huì yóu yǒng le
items.en: My daughter is three and a half now and can already swim.
items.why: 岁 is its own measure, so 半 comes last: 三岁半. 半个 cannot attach to 岁.

items.s: 他是一千九百九十八年出生的。
items.s_py: tā shì yī qiān jiǔ bǎi jiǔ shí bā nián chū shēng de
items.zh: 他是一九九八年出生的。
items.py: tā shì yī jiǔ jiǔ bā nián chū shēng de
items.en: He was born in 1998.
items.why: Years are read digit by digit: 一九九八年. Reading it as a quantity is wrong.

items.zh: 这是我第二次参加比赛。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ dì èr cì cān jiā bǐ sài
items.en: This is my second time in a competition.
items.why: 第二次 is 第 + 二 + 次. 第 must come before the number, and second is 二, not 两.

items.q: 这次比赛，___八十的运动员都参加了第一场。
items.zh: 这次比赛，百分之八十的运动员都参加了第一场。
items.py: zhè cì bǐ sài bǎi fēn zhī bā shí de yùn dòng yuán dōu cān jiā le dì yī chǎng
items.en: Eighty percent of the athletes in this competition took part in the first event.
items.why: Percent is 百分之 + number. 八十百分 copies the English order, and 百分 loses the 之.

items.q: 我今天跑了___，累得不想动了。
items.zh: 我今天跑了三公里多，累得不想动了。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān pǎo le sān gōng lǐ duō lèi de bù xiǎng dòng le
items.en: I ran a bit over three kilometres today and I'm too tired to move.
items.why: With a number from one to nine, the extra bit goes after the measure: 三公里多. 三多公里 puts 多 in the round-number slot.

items.s: 球场上有三十个多人在跑步。
items.s_py: qiú chǎng shàng yǒu sān shí gè duō rén zài pǎo bù
items.zh: 球场上有三十多个人在跑步。
items.py: qiú chǎng shàng yǒu sān shí duō gè rén zài pǎo bù
items.en: There are thirty-odd people running on the field.
items.why: After a round number, 多 comes before the measure: 三十多个人. 三十个多人 splits 多 from the number.

items.q: 球场上有二十___学生在踢球。
items.zh: 球场上有二十多个学生在踢球。
items.py: qiú chǎng shàng yǒu èr shí duō gè xué shēng zài tī qiú
items.en: There are twenty-odd students playing football on the field.
items.why: After a round number like 二十, 多 sits on the number, before the measure: 二十多个. 个多 is for one to nine, and 左右 cannot go before 个.

items.q: 现在___，球赛该开始了。
items.zh: 现在两点半，球赛该开始了。
items.py: xiàn zài liǎng diǎn bàn qiú sài gāi kāi shǐ le
items.en: It's half past two now, the match should start.
items.why: Counting the hour two on a clock is 两点, and 半 comes after 点. 二点 is a classic slip, and 半 can never go in front of the hour.

items.q: 球拍三十九块五，我给了老板五十块，他应该找我___。
items.zh: 球拍三十九块五，我给了老板五十块，他应该找我十块五。
items.py: qiú pāi sān shí jiǔ kuài wǔ wǒ gěi le lǎo bǎn wǔ shí kuài tā yīng gāi zhǎo wǒ shí kuài wǔ
items.en: The racket is 39.50 yuan, and I gave the boss fifty, so he should give me back 10.50.
items.why: Ten yuan and fifty fen is 十块五, with 毛 dropped. 十块零五 would be 10.05, which is not the right change.

items.s: 我弟弟今年二十个岁，已经是队长了。
items.s_py: wǒ dì di jīn nián èr shí gè suì yǐ jīng shì duì zhǎng le
items.zh: 我弟弟今年二十岁，已经是队长了。
items.py: wǒ dì di jīn nián èr shí suì yǐ jīng shì duì zhǎng le
items.en: My younger brother is twenty this year and is already the captain.
items.why: 岁 is itself the measure, so no 个 comes between the number and 岁.

items.q: 这双球鞋一百___块钱，我觉得有点贵。
items.zh: 这双球鞋一百多块钱，我觉得有点贵。
items.py: zhè shuāng qiú xié yī bǎi duō kuài qián wǒ jué de yǒu diǎn guì
items.en: These shoes are a hundred-odd yuan, and I think that's a bit expensive.
items.why: After 一百, 多 follows the number directly: 一百多块. 个多 is not used with 块, and 左右 would have to come after the whole price (一百块左右), not before 块.

items.s: 现在五分差七点，我们快去球场吧。
items.s_py: xiàn zài wǔ fēn chà qī diǎn wǒ men kuài qù qiú chǎng ba
items.zh: 现在差五分七点，我们快去球场吧。
items.py: xiàn zài chà wǔ fēn qī diǎn wǒ men kuài qù qiú chǎng ba
items.en: It's five to seven now, let's hurry to the field.
items.why: 差 has to come first: 差五分七点. The minutes cannot stand in front of 差.

items.zh: 这双球鞋要一千零八十块。
items.py: zhè shuāng qiú xié yào yī qiān líng bā shí kuài
items.en: These sports shoes cost one thousand and eighty yuan.
items.why: 一千零八十: the empty hundreds place gets one 零, between 一千 and 八十.

items.q: 我等了___，他还没来。
items.zh: 我等了半个小时，他还没来。
items.py: wǒ děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí tā hái méi lái
items.en: I've waited half an hour and he still hasn't come.
items.why: Half alone goes before the measure: 半个小时. 小时半 puts 半 last, which is only for units that are their own measure.

items.q: 这辆自行车一千___八十块，不便宜。
items.zh: 这辆自行车一千零八十块，不便宜。
items.py: zhè liàng zì xíng chē yī qiān líng bā shí kuài bù pián yi
items.en: This bike costs one thousand and eighty yuan, which isn't cheap.
items.why: The hundreds place is empty in 1080, so a single 零 follows 千: 一千零八十. 一千百八十 and 一千十八十 are not numbers.

items.zh: 星期六下午三点球场见。
items.py: xīng qī liù xià wǔ sān diǎn qiú chǎng jiàn
items.en: See you at the field at three on Saturday afternoon.
items.why: Weekday, then part of the day, then hour: big to small, with the time before the rest of the sentence.

items.s: 这个乒乓球钱三块。
items.s_py: zhè ge pīng pāng qiú qián sān kuài
items.zh: 这个乒乓球三块钱。
items.py: zhè ge pīng pāng qiú sān kuài qián
items.en: This table tennis ball is three yuan.
items.why: The price follows the subject, and 钱 can only come after the unit (三块钱). 钱 before the number is not Chinese.

items.q: 这是他___次参加马拉松，他说这次一定要跑完。
items.zh: 这是他第三次参加马拉松，他说这次一定要跑完。
items.py: zhè shì tā dì sān cì cān jiā mǎ lā sōng tā shuō zhè cì yī dìng yào pǎo wán
items.en: This is his third time running a marathon, and he says he will definitely finish this time.
items.why: 'The third time' needs 第 before the number: 第三次. 三次 only counts three times, and 第三个次 mixes two measure words.

items.q: 这场比赛有___个人来看，体育场坐满了。
items.zh: 这场比赛有十万个人来看，体育场坐满了。
items.py: zhè chǎng bǐ sài yǒu shí wàn gè rén lái kàn tǐ yù chǎng zuò mǎn le
items.en: A hundred thousand people came to watch the match and the stadium was full.
items.why: Chinese counts in 万, so 100,000 is 十万. 千 never takes a number above nine in front of it, so 一百千 is impossible.

items.s: 我们三点下午明天去爬山。
items.s_py: wǒ men sān diǎn xià wǔ míng tiān qù pá shān
items.zh: 我们明天下午三点去爬山。
items.py: wǒ men míng tiān xià wǔ sān diǎn qù pá shān
items.en: We're going hiking at three tomorrow afternoon.
items.why: Time runs big to small: day, part of the day, hour. 三点下午明天 is English order reversed.

items.zh: 我的孩子两岁半了。
items.py: wǒ de hái zi liǎng suì bàn le
items.en: My child is two and a half now.
items.why: 岁 is its own measure and a counted two is 两: 两岁半, with 半 at the end.

items.q: 现在是十___点，商店里的人越来越多。
items.zh: 现在是十二点，商店里的人越来越多。
items.py: xiàn zài shì shí èr diǎn shāng diàn lǐ de rén yuè lái yuè duō
items.en: It's twelve o'clock now, and the shop is getting more and more crowded.
items.why: Inside 十二点 the digit stays 二. 两 is only for a bare 'two' hour, so 十两点 does not exist.

items.q: 现在五点___，再过十五分钟商店就关门了。
items.zh: 现在五点三刻，再过十五分钟商店就关门了。
items.py: xiàn zài wǔ diǎn sān kè zài guò shí wǔ fēn zhōng shāng diàn jiù guān mén le
items.en: It's a quarter to six now, and the shop closes in fifteen minutes.
items.why: 三刻 is forty-five minutes past the hour, so 五点三刻 is a quarter to six. 一刻 would be 5:15 and 半 would be 5:30, which would not close in fifteen minutes.

items.q: 这瓶运动饮料___块，很便宜。
items.zh: 这瓶运动饮料两块，很便宜。
items.py: zhè píng yùn dòng yǐn liào liǎng kuài hěn pián yi
items.en: This bottle of sports drink is two yuan, very cheap.
items.why: A counted two before 块 is 两: 两块. 二块 is the learner error; 二 is kept for 二十, 十二 and the final digit in 三块二.

items.s: 这个体育场能坐十千人。
items.s_py: zhè ge tǐ yù chǎng néng zuò shí qiān rén
items.zh: 这个体育场能坐一万人。
items.py: zhè ge tǐ yù chǎng néng zuò yī wàn rén
items.en: This stadium holds ten thousand people.
items.why: Ten thousand has its own unit, 万. 千 is never preceded by a number above nine, so 十千 does not exist.

items.q: 这次旅行一共三个___月，我们去了很多地方。
items.zh: 这次旅行一共三个半月，我们去了很多地方。
items.py: zhè cì lǚ xíng yī gòng sān gè bàn yuè wǒ men qù le hěn duō dì fāng
items.en: The trip lasted three and a half months in all, and we visited many places.
items.why: 月 needs 个, so 半 sits between the measure and the noun: 三个半月. 多半 means 'most likely'.

items.zh: 这个月我花了工资的三分之一。
items.py: zhè ge yuè wǒ huā le gōng zī de sān fēn zhī yī
items.en: This month I spent a third of my salary.
items.why: 三分之一: denominator first, then 分之, then the numerator. 一分之三 would be three over one.

items.zh: 小王住在五楼。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zhù zài wǔ lóu
items.en: Xiao Wang lives on the fifth floor.
items.why: Floors use a bare number: 五楼, with no 第.

items.q: 我打了三___月网球，打得越来越好了。
items.zh: 我打了三个多月网球，打得越来越好了。
items.py: wǒ dǎ le sān gè duō yuè wǎng qiú dǎ de yuè lái yuè hǎo le
items.en: I've played tennis for a bit over three months and am getting better.
items.why: With a number from one to nine, 多 follows the measure: 三个多月. 三多个月 and 三多月 put 多 where a round number would take it.

items.q: 我们___去打羽毛球。
opts: 一月十号明年四点下午
下午四点十号一月明年
明年一月十号下午四点
items.zh: 我们明年一月十号下午四点去打羽毛球。
items.py: wǒ men míng nián yī yuè shí hào xià wǔ sì diǎn qù dǎ yǔ máo qiú
items.en: We're going to play badminton at four on the afternoon of January 10th next year.
items.why: Year, month, day, part of the day, hour: always largest first, all before 去. The other options scramble that order or put the small units first.

items.zh: 我的房间是四幺五。
items.py: wǒ de fáng jiān shì sì yāo wǔ
items.en: My room is 415.
items.why: Room numbers are read digit by digit, and the digit one is said 幺: 四幺五.

items.zh: 我们等了一个半小时。
items.py: wǒ men děng le yī gè bàn xiǎo shí
items.en: We waited for an hour and a half.
items.why: With a whole number, 半 goes after the measure 个 and before 小时: 一个半小时.

items.q: 我学打网球已经___了，下个月就要参加比赛。
items.zh: 我学打网球已经两个月了，下个月就要参加比赛。
items.py: wǒ xué dǎ wǎng qiú yǐ jīng liǎng gè yuè le xià gè yuè jiù yào cān jiā bǐ sài
items.en: I've been learning tennis for two months and will enter a competition next month.
items.why: Here a length of time is counted, so it is 两个月. 二月 and 第二月 name February or the second month, not a duration.

items.q: 这是我___次来这个球场。
items.zh: 这是我第二次来这个球场。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ dì èr cì lái zhè ge qiú chǎng
items.en: This is my second time at this field.
items.why: An ordinal is 第 + number, and second is 第二, never 第两. 两次 would just count two times, not say it is the second.

items.q: 球赛从七___开始，打了两个小时。
items.zh: 球赛从七点开始，打了两个小时。
items.py: qiú sài cóng qī diǎn kāi shǐ dǎ le liǎng gè xiǎo shí
items.en: The match started at seven o'clock and lasted two hours.
items.why: A clock time takes 点, a length of time takes 小时. 七个小时 would be seven hours, which clashes with the two hours played.

items.zh: 我们七点左右到。
items.py: wǒ men qī diǎn zuǒ yòu dào
items.en: We'll arrive at about seven.
items.why: 左右 comes after the number phrase: 七点左右. It cannot stand before 七点.

items.zh: 我们在海边玩了两天半。
items.py: wǒ men zài hǎi biān wán le liǎng tiān bàn
items.en: We spent two and a half days at the seaside.
items.why: 天 is its own measure, so 半 comes last: 两天半.

items.zh: 这个排球三块五。
items.py: zhè ge pái qiú sān kuài wǔ
items.en: This volleyball is three yuan fifty.
items.why: 块 first, then the dropped-unit 五: 三块五, 3.50 yuan.

items.q: 我弟弟上___年级，已经会游泳了。
items.zh: 我弟弟上二年级，已经会游泳了。
items.py: wǒ dì di shàng èr nián jí yǐ jīng huì yóu yǒng le
items.en: My younger brother is in second grade and can already swim.
items.why: School grades are position names, so they take the bare number: 二年级. 两年级 and 第二年级 are not used.

items.s: 我们踢了一个小时半足球。
items.s_py: wǒ men tī le yī gè xiǎo shí bàn zú qiú
items.zh: 我们踢了一个半小时足球。
items.py: wǒ men tī le yī gè bàn xiǎo shí zú qiú
items.en: We played football for an hour and a half.
items.why: 半 attaches right after the measure 个 and before 小时: 一个半小时. 一个小时半 puts it at the end.

items.q: 比赛七点一___开始，快走吧。
items.zh: 比赛七点一刻开始，快走吧。
items.py: bǐ sài qī diǎn yī kè kāi shǐ kuài zǒu ba
items.en: The match starts at a quarter past seven, let's hurry.
items.why: A quarter past is 点 + 一刻. 七点一分 would be one minute past seven, and 半 would be seven thirty, so neither fits 'quarter past'.

items.s: 今天星期六，我们去打球吧。
items.s_py: jīn tiān xīng qī liù wǒ men qù dǎ qiú ba
items.zh: 今天星期六，我们去打球吧。
items.py: jīn tiān xīng qī liù wǒ men qù dǎ qiú ba
items.en: It's Saturday today, let's go and play ball.
items.why: A positive weekday sentence needs no 是: 今天星期六 is the normal way to say it, so nothing is missing here.

items.q: 我只买了___个乒乓球，用不了多久。
items.zh: 我只买了几个乒乓球，用不了多久。
items.py: wǒ zhǐ mǎi le jǐ gè pīng pāng qiú yòng bù liǎo duō jiǔ
items.en: I only bought a few table tennis balls, they won't last long.
items.why: 几 stands in for a small unknown number and sits in the number slot before 个. 左右 and 大概 both need a real number to go with.

items.q: 这双球鞋三百___五块。
items.zh: 这双球鞋三百零五块。
items.py: zhè shuāng qiú xié sān bǎi líng wǔ kuài
items.en: These sports shoes cost three hundred and five yuan.
items.why: The tens place is empty, so one 零 fills the gap: 三百零五. Without it, 三百五 means 350 in speech, and 三百十五 is not said.

items.q: 他们是二零一零年六月十二号___在北京结婚的。
items.zh: 他们是二零一零年六月十二号晚上八点在北京结婚的。
items.py: tā men shì èr líng yī líng nián liù yuè shí èr hào wǎn shàng bā diǎn zài běi jīng jié hūn de
items.en: They got married in Beijing at eight in the evening on June 12th, 2010.
items.why: The part of the day comes before the hour (晚上八点), after the date. 八点晚上 copies the English habit of putting the hour first.

items.q: 他每天八点___起床，所以上班总是迟到。
items.zh: 他每天八点半起床，所以上班总是迟到。
items.py: tā měi tiān bā diǎn bàn qǐ chuáng suǒ yǐ shàng bān zǒng shì chí dào
items.en: He gets up at half past eight every day, so he is always late for work.
items.why: Half past is 点 + 半, with nothing else added. 三十半 doubles up, and thirty minutes is never called 两刻.

items.q: 我儿子是二零一八年___出生的。
items.zh: 我儿子是二零一八年三月十二号出生的。
items.py: wǒ ér zi shì èr líng yī bā nián sān yuè shí èr hào chū shēng de
items.en: My son was born on March 12th, 2018.
items.why: After the year comes the month, then the day. 十二号三月 puts the day before the month, which is the reverse of Chinese order.

items.q: 我的房间号是六八___，在六楼。
items.zh: 我的房间号是六八二，在六楼。
items.py: wǒ de fáng jiān hào shì liù bā èr zài liù lóu
items.en: My room number is 682, on the sixth floor.
items.why: Digits in a room number are read one by one, and two stays 二. 两 belongs to counting, such as 两个人.

items.zh: 我们俱乐部有一百零五个会员。
items.py: wǒ men jù lè bù yǒu yī bǎi líng wǔ gè huì yuán
items.en: Our club has a hundred and five members.
items.why: 一百零五: one 零 fills the empty tens place. 一百五 would be 150.

items.q: 我们___到球场，你别迟到。
items.zh: 我们七点左右到球场，你别迟到。
items.py: wǒ men qī diǎn zuǒ yòu dào qiú chǎng nǐ bié chí dào
items.en: We'll get to the field at about seven, don't be late.
items.why: 左右 follows the whole number phrase: 七点左右. The word that goes in front of the number is 大概, never 左右.

items.zh: 火车九点零五分开。
items.py: huǒ chē jiǔ diǎn líng wǔ fēn kāi
items.en: The train leaves at five past nine.
items.why: Minutes under ten take 零 after 点: 九点零五分. The time stays before the verb 开.

items.zh: 操场上有三十多个人在跑步。
items.py: cāo chǎng shàng yǒu sān shí duō gè rén zài pǎo bù
items.en: There are thirty-odd people running on the sports field.
items.why: After a round number like 三十, 多 comes before the measure: 三十多个人.

items.q: 我儿子今年___岁了。
items.zh: 我儿子今年两岁了。
items.py: wǒ ér zi jīn nián liǎng suì le
items.en: My son is two this year.
items.why: Two years old is 两岁, because 岁 is a measure and a counted two is 两. 二岁 is the learner error.

items.q: 我们队里___二的队员是女生，剩下的是男生。
items.zh: 我们队里三分之二的队员是女生，剩下的是男生。
items.py: wǒ men duì lǐ sān fēn zhī èr de duì yuán shì nǚ shēng shèng xià de shì nán shēng
items.en: Two thirds of the players on our team are girls and the rest are boys.
items.why: The denominator comes first: 三分之二 is two thirds. 二分之二 would be all of them, and 三之分 scrambles 分之.

items.q: 你买了两个排球，一共___，请扫码付钱。
items.zh: 你买了两个排球，一共四十六块八，请扫码付钱。
items.py: nǐ mǎi le liǎng gè pái qiú yī gòng sì shí liù kuài bā qǐng sǎo mǎ fù qián
items.en: You bought two volleyballs, 46.80 yuan altogether, please scan to pay.
items.why: The big unit goes first: 四十六块, then 八. Putting 块 after the small number or the small number first is not Chinese price order.

items.s: 这双运动鞋一百十块钱，太贵了。
items.s_py: zhè shuāng yùn dòng xié yī bǎi shí kuài qián tài guì le
items.zh: 这双运动鞋一百一十块钱，太贵了。
items.py: zhè shuāng yùn dòng xié yī bǎi yī shí kuài qián tài guì le
items.en: These sports shoes are a hundred and ten yuan, which is too expensive.
items.why: Inside a bigger number ten is said 一十: 一百一十. 一百十 skips the 一.

items.s: 我第二月去北京参加比赛。
items.s_py: wǒ dì èr yuè qù běi jīng cān jiā bǐ sài
items.zh: 我二月去北京参加比赛。
items.py: wǒ èr yuè qù běi jīng cān jiā bǐ sài
items.en: I'm going to Beijing for a competition in February.
items.why: Month names are bare numbers, so 二月. 第二月 would mean 'the second month' as an ordinal, which is not how months are named.

items.zh: 球赛十二月三十号晚上七点开始。
items.py: qiú sài shí èr yuè sān shí hào wǎn shàng qī diǎn kāi shǐ
items.en: The match starts at seven in the evening on December 30th.
items.why: The date comes before the part of the day and hour, and the whole time expression is in front of 开始.

items.q: 我是___年开始学网球的。
items.zh: 我是二零一五年开始学网球的。
items.py: wǒ shì èr líng yī wǔ nián kāi shǐ xué wǎng qiú de
items.en: I started learning tennis in 2015.
items.why: Years are read digit by digit: 二零一五. Reading them as a quantity (二千十五) is not Chinese.

items.s: 羽毛球两块五一个，你买几个？
items.s_py: yǔ máo qiú liǎng kuài wǔ yī gè nǐ mǎi jǐ gè
items.zh: 羽毛球两块五一个，你买几个？
items.py: yǔ máo qiú liǎng kuài wǔ yī gè nǐ mǎi jǐ gè
items.en: Shuttlecocks are two yuan fifty each, how many do you want?
items.why: Two is 两 before 块, and the last unit is dropped: 两块五. No 是 or 有 is needed before a price.

items.s: 我住三楼，球场在二楼。
items.s_py: wǒ zhù sān lóu qiú chǎng zài èr lóu
items.zh: 我住三楼，球场在二楼。
items.py: wǒ zhù sān lóu qiú chǎng zài èr lóu
items.en: I live on the third floor, and the court is on the second floor.
items.why: Floors take bare numbers (三楼, 二楼) with no 第, and two stays 二 in an ordered name.

items.q: 这个月我们花了工资的___，买了不少运动装备。
items.zh: 这个月我们花了工资的三分之一，买了不少运动装备。
items.py: zhè ge yuè wǒ men huā le gōng zī de sān fēn zhī yī mǎi le bù shǎo yùn dòng zhuāng bèi
items.en: This month we spent a third of our pay on sports gear.
items.why: A fraction names the bottom number first: 三分之一. 一分之三 reverses it, which would mean three over one.

items.q: 已经___了，比赛马上开始，你怎么还在逛商店？
items.zh: 已经差十分十点了，比赛马上开始，你怎么还在逛商店？
items.py: yǐ jīng chà shí fēn shí diǎn le bǐ sài mǎ shàng kāi shǐ nǐ zěn me hái zài guàng shāng diàn
items.en: It's already ten to ten and the match is about to start, so why are you still shopping?
items.why: 'Ten to ten' is 差 + minutes + hour: 差十分十点. The minutes cannot stand in front of 差, and 差十点十分 would mean lacking ten o'clock.

items.q: 这家体育用品公司去年赚了三___块，老板很高兴。
items.zh: 这家体育用品公司去年赚了三千万块，老板很高兴。
items.py: zhè jiā tǐ yù yòng pǐn gōng sī qù nián zhuàn le sān qiān wàn kuài lǎo bǎn hěn gāo xìng
items.en: This sports goods company made thirty million yuan last year, and the boss was very pleased.
items.why: Thirty million is three thousand 万: 三千万. 三百万 is only three million, and 三万万 is not how it is said.

items.q: 我们队这次得了___名，只比第一名少两分。
items.zh: 我们队这次得了第二名，只比第一名少两分。
items.py: wǒ men duì zhè cì de le dì èr míng zhǐ bǐ dì yī míng shǎo liǎng fēn
items.en: Our team came second this time, only two points behind first.
items.why: A rank is 第 + number + 名, and second is 第二. 第两名 is the classic mistake, and 两名 would mean two people.

items.q: 我学游泳已经学了___，可以参加比赛了。
items.zh: 我学游泳已经学了一年半，可以参加比赛了。
items.py: wǒ xué yóu yǒng yǐ jīng xué le yī nián bàn kě yǐ cān jiā bǐ sài le
items.en: I've been learning to swim for a year and a half, and can enter races now.
items.why: 年 is its own measure, so a whole number plus half is 一年半, with 半 last. The other two reorder the pieces.

items.zh: 一共是四十六块八。
items.py: yī gòng shì sì shí liù kuài bā
items.en: That's forty-six yuan eighty altogether.
items.why: The big unit 四十六块 comes first and the final 八 follows it with 毛 dropped.

items.s: 这双球鞋一千零五十块，比上个月贵了三百多块。
items.s_py: zhè shuāng qiú xié yī qiān líng wǔ shí kuài bǐ shàng gè yuè guì le sān bǎi duō kuài
items.zh: 这双球鞋一千零五十块，比上个月贵了三百多块。
items.py: zhè shuāng qiú xié yī qiān líng wǔ shí kuài bǐ shàng gè yuè guì le sān bǎi duō kuài
items.en: These shoes are one thousand and fifty yuan, three hundred-odd yuan more than last month.
items.why: 一千零五十 has one 零 for the empty hundreds place, and 三百多块 puts 多 right after the round number. Both are correct.

items.q: 他今年一共跑了一百___公里，真厉害。
items.zh: 他今年一共跑了一百一十公里，真厉害。
items.py: tā jīn nián yī gòng pǎo le yī bǎi yī shí gōng lǐ zhēn lì hài
items.en: He ran 110 kilometres in total this year, which is impressive.
items.why: Inside a bigger number ten is said 一十: 一百一十. 一百十 skips the 一, and 零 is only for an empty place, not for a ten.

items.q: 球赛在___开始。
items.zh: 球赛在星期六下午三点开始。
items.py: qiú sài zài xīng qī liù xià wǔ sān diǎn kāi shǐ
items.en: The match starts at three on Saturday afternoon.
items.why: Time runs from big to small: weekday, part of the day, hour. The other tiles start from the hour, which is English order and not Chinese.

items.q: 乒乓球馆在___楼。
items.zh: 乒乓球馆在三楼。
items.py: pīng pāng qiú guǎn zài sān lóu
items.en: The table tennis hall is on the third floor.
items.why: Floors name a position with a bare number: 三楼. 第 is not added, and 三个楼 would be three separate buildings.

items.q: 这家俱乐部才成立了两年___，会员却已经有两千多人了。
items.zh: 这家俱乐部才成立了两年多，会员却已经有两千多人了。
items.py: zhè jiā jù lè bù cái chéng lì le liǎng nián duō huì yuán què yǐ jīng yǒu liǎng qiān duō rén le
items.en: This club has only been set up for a little over two years, yet it already has over two thousand members.
items.why: 年 is its own measure, so 多 follows it: 两年多. 两个年多 wrongly adds 个, and 左右多 is not a pattern.

items.q: 这个气球三块___，买两个吧。
items.zh: 这个气球三块五，买两个吧。
items.py: zhè ge qì qiú sān kuài wǔ mǎi liǎng gè ba
items.en: This balloon is three yuan fifty, buy two.
items.why: 钱 can only follow a complete unit (五块钱), not a dropped one. 三块五钱 and 三块五块钱 both repeat or break the unit pattern.

items.zh: 现在差五分八点。
items.py: xiàn zài chà wǔ fēn bā diǎn
items.en: It's five to eight now.
items.why: 差 comes before the minutes: 差五分八点. 五分差八点 is wrong, because the minutes cannot stand before 差.

items.q: 今天不___星期六，是星期天。
items.zh: 今天不是星期六，是星期天。
items.py: jīn tiān bú shì xīng qī liù shì xīng qī tiān
items.en: Today isn't Saturday, it's Sunday.
items.why: A positive weekday can drop 是 (今天星期六), but 不 needs 是 after it. 不星期六 is impossible, and 有 does not state what day it is.

items.zh: 百分之八十的球迷都来了。
items.py: bǎi fēn zhī bā shí de qiú mí dōu lái le
items.en: Eighty percent of the fans came.
items.why: 百分之 goes first, then the number: 百分之八十. The number cannot come before 百分之.

items.s: 现在差十分九点，球赛快开始了。
items.s_py: xiàn zài chà shí fēn jiǔ diǎn qiú sài kuài kāi shǐ le
items.zh: 现在差十分九点，球赛快开始了。
items.py: xiàn zài chà shí fēn jiǔ diǎn qiú sài kuài kāi shǐ le
items.en: It's ten to nine now, and the match is about to start.
items.why: 差 comes before the minutes and the coming hour comes last: 差十分九点 is exactly right.

items.s: 现在二点半，球赛开始了。
items.s_py: xiàn zài èr diǎn bàn qiú sài kāi shǐ le
items.zh: 现在两点半，球赛开始了。
items.py: xiàn zài liǎng diǎn bàn qiú sài kāi shǐ le
items.en: It's half past two now, and the match has started.
items.why: The hour two before 点 is 两, so 二点 is the error. 二 stays only in 十二点 and in minutes.

items.q: 这件运动服一百二十三块___，你要吗？
items.zh: 这件运动服一百二十三块五毛，你要吗？
items.py: zhè jiàn yùn dòng fú yī bǎi èr shí sān kuài wǔ máo nǐ yào ma
items.en: This tracksuit is 123 yuan 50, do you want it?
items.why: After 块 comes the number and then 毛, largest unit first: 五毛. The number must stand in front of 毛, so 毛五 reverses it.

items.s: 我打了半年乒乓球，就喜欢上了。
items.s_py: wǒ dǎ le bàn nián pīng pāng qiú jiù xǐ huān shàng le
items.zh: 我打了半年乒乓球，就喜欢上了。
items.py: wǒ dǎ le bàn nián pīng pāng qiú jiù xǐ huān shàng le
items.en: I played table tennis for half a year and grew to like it.
items.why: Half alone goes before the measure, and 年 takes no 个: 半年 is correct.

items.q: 中国有十四___人，喜欢打乒乓球的人很多。
items.zh: 中国有十四亿人，喜欢打乒乓球的人很多。
items.py: zhōng guó yǒu shí sì yì rén xǐ huān dǎ pīng pāng qiú de rén hěn duō
items.en: China has 1.4 billion people, and many of them like playing table tennis.
items.why: 1.4 billion is 十四亿, because 亿 is a hundred million. 十四万 would be only 140,000 and 十四千万 is not a possible number.

items.q: 来看比赛的有两万___人，座位都坐满了。
items.zh: 来看比赛的有两万多人，座位都坐满了。
items.py: lái kàn bǐ sài de yǒu liǎng wàn duō rén zuò wèi dōu zuò mǎn le
items.en: More than twenty thousand people came to watch the match, and all the seats were full.
items.why: After a round number, 多 comes straight after it: 两万多人. 左右 would have to follow 人 (两万人左右), and 个多 does not work with 万.

items.q: 我住在八___八房间。
items.zh: 我住在八二八房间。
items.py: wǒ zhù zài bā èr bā fáng jiān
items.en: I'm staying in room 828.
items.why: Room numbers are read digit by digit, and the digit two stays 二. 两 is for counting two of something.

items.q: 我想买___年的健身卡，一年的太贵了。
items.zh: 我想买半年的健身卡，一年的太贵了。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi bàn nián de jiàn shēn kǎ yī nián de tài guì le
items.en: I want to buy a half-year gym card, since a full year is too expensive.
items.why: Half alone goes before the measure, and 年 takes no 个: 半年. 半个年 is the learner error, and 一半 means half of something.

items.q: 这家体育俱乐部是___年成立的，已经有二十多年的历史了。
items.zh: 这家体育俱乐部是一九九八年成立的，已经有二十多年的历史了。
items.py: zhè jiā tǐ yù jù lè bù shì yī jiǔ jiǔ bā nián chéng lì de yǐ jīng yǒu èr shí duō nián de lì shǐ le
items.en: This sports club was founded in 1998 and has more than twenty years of history.
items.why: A year is read digit by digit: 一九九八. Reading it as a quantity, 一千九百九十八, is something no native does.

items.s: 他跑了三个多小时，累坏了。
items.s_py: tā pǎo le sān gè duō xiǎo shí lèi huài le
items.zh: 他跑了三个多小时，累坏了。
items.py: tā pǎo le sān gè duō xiǎo shí lèi huài le
items.en: He ran for a bit over three hours and was exhausted.
items.why: With a number from one to nine, 多 follows the measure: 三个多小时. This is the correct slot.

items.s: 他今年左右三十岁，是我们的教练。
items.s_py: tā jīn nián zuǒ yòu sān shí suì shì wǒ men de jiào liàn
items.zh: 他今年三十岁左右，是我们的教练。
items.py: tā jīn nián sān shí suì zuǒ yòu shì wǒ men de jiào liàn
items.en: He is about thirty this year and is our coach.
items.why: 左右 follows the number phrase: 三十岁左右. It can never stand before the number.

items.q: 你的孩子今年___岁了？
items.zh: 你的孩子今年几岁了？
items.py: nǐ de hái zi jīn nián jǐ suì le
items.en: How old is your child this year?
items.why: A child's age is asked with 几 straight before 岁. 几个岁 adds a measure word 岁 never takes, and 哪 is not a number word.

items.q: 这款运动手表去年一共卖了两千___八个。
items.zh: 这款运动手表去年一共卖了两千零八个。
items.py: zhè kuǎn yùn dòng shǒu biǎo qù nián yī gòng mài le liǎng qiān líng bā gè
items.en: This sports watch sold two thousand and eight units in total last year.
items.why: 2008 has two empty places in the middle, and they get a single 零: 两千零八. Writing 两千八 would mean 2,800.

items.q: 我们的比赛在___月举行。
items.zh: 我们的比赛在二月举行。
items.py: wǒ men de bǐ sài zài èr yuè jǔ xíng
items.en: Our match is held in February.
items.why: Month names are bare numbers, and February is 二月. 两月 and 第二月 do not exist; 两个月 would be a length of two months.

items.zh: 他今天跑了三公里多。
items.py: tā jīn tiān pǎo le sān gōng lǐ duō
items.en: He ran a bit over three kilometres today.
items.why: With a number from one to nine, 多 follows the measure: 三公里多. 三多公里 is wrong.

items.q: 我只买了___个乒乓球。
items.zh: 我只买了一个乒乓球。
items.py: wǒ zhǐ mǎi le yī gè pīng pāng qiú
items.en: I only bought one table tennis ball.
items.why: 幺 is only for digit strings like phone and room numbers. A counted one is always 一.

items.q: 我的手机只剩___二十的电了，别玩游戏了。
items.zh: 我的手机只剩百分之二十的电了，别玩游戏了。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī zhǐ shèng bǎi fēn zhī èr shí de diàn le bié wán yóu xì le
items.en: My phone only has twenty percent battery left, so stop playing games.
items.why: 百分之 goes in front of the number: 百分之二十. The number can never come before 百分, and 之 cannot be left out.

items.q: 一个乒乓球三块___，一盒十个。
items.zh: 一个乒乓球三块五，一盒十个。
items.py: yī gè pīng pāng qiú sān kuài wǔ yī hé shí gè
items.en: A table tennis ball is three yuan fifty, ten to a box.
items.why: The last unit is dropped, so 三块五 means 3.50. 三块五块 repeats the unit, and 是 is not needed between 块 and the number.

items.q: 银行___点关门，我们快去取钱吧。
items.zh: 银行两点关门，我们快去取钱吧。
items.py: yín háng liǎng diǎn guān mén wǒ men kuài qù qǔ qián ba
items.en: The bank closes at two, let's hurry and withdraw some money.
items.why: The hour two before 点 is always 两: 两点. 二点 is the learner error; 二 stays inside 十二点 and in minutes like 二十分.

items.zh: 比赛三点一刻开始。
items.py: bǐ sài sān diǎn yī kè kāi shǐ
items.en: The match starts at a quarter past three.
items.why: 一刻 follows 三点 directly, and the clock time sits before the verb 开始.

items.s: 我们队三分之二的队员是学生，剩下的是老师。
items.s_py: wǒ men duì sān fēn zhī èr de duì yuán shì xué shēng shèng xià de shì lǎo shī
items.zh: 我们队三分之二的队员是学生，剩下的是老师。
items.py: wǒ men duì sān fēn zhī èr de duì yuán shì xué shēng shèng xià de shì lǎo shī
items.en: Two thirds of the players on our team are students, and the rest are teachers.
items.why: 三分之二 names the denominator first and then the numerator, so two thirds is written exactly like this.

items.q: 报警电话是___。
items.zh: 报警电话是幺幺零。
items.py: bào jǐng diàn huà shì yāo yāo líng
items.en: The police emergency number is 110.
items.why: Phone numbers are read digit by digit, with 幺 for one. 一百一十 is the quantity one hundred and ten.
